facts.text: ScopeDriver is the profile-driven driver that turns semantic operations into RIGOL SCPI and parses the replies
identify queries *IDN? and splits the reply into manufacturer, model, serial and firmware
get_channel reads the display, vertical scale, offset, coupling, impedance, probe ratio and bandwidth limit of one channel
get_timebase reads the main timebase scale and offset and the sample rate and memory depth
get_trigger reads the current trigger type's subtree plus the sweep mode and trigger status
measure queries :MEASure:ITEM? for each requested item and reports a sentinel value as unknown
configure_trigger writes the trigger mode first when asked, then each requested subtree item, and reads every setting back
set_channel_scale writes :CHANnelN:SCALe and returns the read-back value
set_timebase_scale writes :TIMebase:MAIN:SCALe and returns the read-back value
run writes :RUN and stop writes :STOP through the checked SCPI session
get_trigger_status queries :TRIGger:STATus? and strips and uppercases its reply
write_checked writes the command then calls check_error, which queries ERROR_QUERY and raises ScopeError on an error reply
The generic profile declares four analog channels, the measurements frequency, period, vpp, vmax and vmin, edge trigger, screenshot and waveform download
The screenshot and waveform reads return IEEE 488.2 binary blocks through query_binary
read_waveform writes the waveform source, mode and format, reads the preamble and then transfers :WAVeform:DATA? as a binary block
The LAN transport is a raw TCP socket whose default port is 5555
The upstream connection resolves the model profile from the *IDN? reply and builds a ScopeDriver over the session

operator_required.name: channel1_scale_v_per_div
operator_required.reason: the generic profile states no vertical-scale range; the model and probe ratio set it, so the operator supplies the bound (scope.py:1358-1363)

operator_required.name: channel1_offset_v
operator_required.reason: the generic profile states no offset range; it depends on the vertical scale and probe ratio, so the operator supplies the bound (scope.py:1366-1371)

operator_required.name: timebase_scale_s_per_div
operator_required.reason: the generic profile states no timebase range; the model and acquisition mode set it, so the operator supplies the bound (scope.py:1435-1439)

operator_required.name: timebase_position_s
operator_required.reason: the generic profile states no horizontal-position range; the timebase scale sets it, so the operator supplies the bound (scope.py:1441-1445)

operator_required.name: configure_trigger
operator_required.reason: the clone states no holdoff range; it depends on the timebase and trigger mode (scope.py:1449-1518)

operator_required.name: configure_trigger
operator_required.reason: the clone states no trigger-level range; it depends on the source, vertical scale and offset (scope.py:1449-1518)

safe_state.description: acquisition reports STOP after the checked :STOP command; no electrical isolation is claimed and any independently enabled AFG output is unchanged; a missing or different status fails the stop
